tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: A practitioner's open time windows over up to 14 days, optionally for one service (only windows long enough for it). Read-only: nothing is held or booked. Returns JSON {result: {practitioner, url, service?, from, to, times_are: "UTC", open_windows: [{start, end}], book_url, how_to_book}, note}. To book, call open_booking; the person picks the time and pays.

slug.description: The practitioner: the last part of its Gyfts URL.

from.description: First day to check (YYYY-MM-DD). Default today.

days.description: How many days to check. Default 7.

tools.name: find_offerings
tools.description: List published courses, workshops, programs, retreats, classes, 1:1 sessions and events on Gyfts, optionally by format, price, country and date range. Returns JSON {results: [{name, url, by, format, price, starts?, where?}], page, next_page?, note}, 6 per page, soonest first unless sorted by price (prices compared as listed, not converted). Call get_offering with a url for details. Read-only: it does not book anything; the person books on the page.

kind.description: Which kind of offering to list.

query.description: Optional words to match in the title or host name.

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. IE or US.

from.description: Only items starting on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Excludes undated items.

to.description: Only items starting on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Excludes undated items.

page.description: Page of results, from 1. Use next_page from the previous answer.

tools.name: find_practitioners
tools.description: List published Gyfts practitioners who offer a practice or modality, e.g. "reiki" or "acupuncture", optionally in a country or city. Returns JSON {matched: {name, url}, results: [{name, url, where?, verified?}], page, next_page?, note}, 6 per page, verified practitioners first unless sort is "name". Call get_practitioner with the last part of a url for services, prices and formats. Read-only. Directory information only, not medical advice.

practice.description: The practice or modality name, e.g. "reiki".

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. IE or US.

sort.description: verified: verified first, then A–Z (default). name: A–Z.

page.description: Page of results, from 1. Use next_page from the previous answer.

tools.name: get_offering
tools.description: Details of one event, course, workshop, retreat, organization offering or practitioner session, from a url returned by find_offerings. Returns JSON {result: {type, name, url, host?, starts?, ends?, timezone?, format?, where?, price?, minutes?, tickets?: [{name, price}], about?, how_to_book}, note}. Read-only.

url.description: The offering url from find_offerings, e.g. /events/sound-bath-dublin.

tools.name: get_practitioner
tools.description: A published Gyfts practitioner's public profile summary. Returns JSON {result: {name, url, where?, verified?, practices?, specialties?, languages?, years_experience?, formats?, about?, services?: [{id, name, price, minutes?, format?}], book_url?}, note}. No contact details. Use a service id with check_availability and open_booking.

slug.description: The practitioner, e.g. "jane-doe" from /ie/jane-doe: the last part of its Gyfts URL.

tools.name: get_this_page
tools.description: Details of the practitioner, topic or offering shown on the current Gyfts page, in the same shape get_practitioner, get_topic or get_offering return. Returns JSON {result: {...} | null, error?, note}; result is null on pages that are not about one of those (e.g. the homepage or a listing).

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Details of one condition, symptom, practice, treatment, specialty or journey on Gyfts: its reviewed short summary and page URL, and for a condition the practices its page lists. Returns JSON {result: {type, name, url, summary?, related_practices?: [{name, url}], next_step?}, note}. A listed practice is not a recommendation. Not medical advice, a diagnosis or a treatment plan.

type.description: practice = a modality (/modalities/…); journey = a pathway (/journey/…).

slug.description: The topic, e.g. "anxiety" from /conditions/anxiety: the last part of its Gyfts URL.

tools.name: open_booking
tools.description: Open a practitioner's Gyfts booking page, optionally with one service chosen, so the person can pick a time and pay. The agent does not book or pay: the person signs in and completes it themselves. Returns JSON {opened} or {error}.

slug.description: The practitioner: the last part of its Gyfts URL.

tools.name: open_gyfts_search
tools.description: Open the Gyfts search results page for a search term. Results cover conditions, symptoms, practices (modalities), treatments, specialties, journeys, practitioners, organizations, events and articles. Navigates this tab to the public results page; nothing is booked or changed. Gyfts is a directory: results are not medical advice, a diagnosis or a treatment recommendation.

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Navigate this tab to a public Gyfts page, e.g. a url from any other tool. Only Gyfts pages; account, admin, sign-in and booking pages are refused (use open_booking to book). Returns JSON {opened} or {error}.

url.description: A Gyfts path such as /modalities/reiki, or a full gyfts.io URL.

tools.name: search_gyfts
tools.description: Search the Gyfts holistic health directory by name: conditions, symptoms, practices (modalities), treatments, specialties, journeys (pathways), practitioners, organizations, events and articles. Returns JSON {results: [{type, name, detail?, url}], page, next_page?, note}, 6 per page. For details of one result call get_topic, get_practitioner or get_offering. To find practitioners who offer a practice (e.g. reiki), use find_practitioners. Directory information only, not medical advice.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "reiki", "anxiety", or a practitioner name.

type.description: Only return results of this type. "modality" is a practice; "pathway" is a journey.

page.description: Page of results, from 1. Use next_page from the previous answer.
